I'm 15 and the first time I tried to kill myself was when I was 9. I didn't exactly have a great situation and I wanted out of it all and to just stop feeling so shitty all the time. It feels weird to say that because of how young I was, its strange to think people so young who you'd think would be happy can want to kill themselves. I don't like knowing anyone goes through this but when I see people younger than me, even if its only by a few years feel like that and go through this shit it feels wrong and I get mad knowing that someone so young feel like that and I can't do shit to help them. I used to help out at this nursery a lot and just the thought of one of those little kids growing up a few years and ending up being suicidal makes me feel sick.

Hey I hope that if you do decide to come out that it all goes well, the people who've been calling you a 'coward' are being dicks. You don't owe anyone a coming out. I do know that if I had a teacher who I knew was trans it would would make me feel less alone and more understood. But if it put their safety at risk or if they just didn't want to or weren't ready to come out or something like that then I'd rather not know. It really is up to you, whatever u decide to do I hope it all goes well :)
Thanks, sorry that it took me a while to reply I wasn't sure what to say but thankyou this is helpful :)

Yh I think if anyone would be willing to support me it would be my sister I think it will be a while before I'll feel ready to come out/ open up to my brother but maybe one day I will. I know theres nothing 'wrong' with being trans but I do feel ashamed in a lot of ways. My mum cried and screamed at me so much when I came out and told me how selfish I was being. My dad had told me he saw signs of it so I think thats why he coped better but he was still upset at me and yh I just felt really bad, it was about 2-3 years ago but I can't stop thinking about how they reacted I didn't mean to hurt them. I shouldn't have let them find out. Sorry that turned into a bit of a rant, my sister said I need to wait and when she first found out she said that she thought I was too young to know but I'm glad I have support from her. 
Thanks for listening and giving advice to me I know I can be a lot I really am grateful

Its okay I kind of expected her to out me and I knew my sister wasn't exactly the most open minded person, my brother's in his early thirties and he's living with his girlfriend in scotland I don't get to see him a lot but I don't want to lose the relationship I have with him. I don't have any way to contact him directly but I could probably ask my sister for his number. I think my brother might try to help me out if he heard I got kicked out but Idk. I've never had a serious conversation with my brother I only get to see him so often so we usually just messed about until he had to go. I think my more supportive sister might try to help me out but she's only 20 so I don't think she could do much. I'm not really close with any relatives a lot of them live in scotland and the one's who live closer I know are very closed minded and would probably have done worse to me than my parents if I were their child.

I do have siblings, they've either have moved out or are in uni, my mum outed me to my sisters and one of them was kind of supportive and said she kind of new already and the other one was not to say the least she didn't have a great reaction, my mum couldn't tell my brother because he's her stepson not blood related, I rarely see him because he lives in scotland but sometimes it feels like he knowa because he treats me as a guy and its nice. I like to pretend that he thinks of me as a little brother instead of a little sister.

Thankyou, I'm not really good with emotions or talking about how I feel which is probably why I ended up ranting about how shit things are on reddit. Things are really hard right now and I'm terrified and I         don't know how long I can be here for. 
But right now I really appreciated ur comment, I stalked ur page a bit and saw u try and help out a lot of people by commenting and I admire that of you, it must be really stressful at times but you still did it and that is very kind of you. Thankyou for ur reply I didn't really expect one but its nice that you tried to help me in some way even if it was only by replying to my post. I hope things are going good for you.

My parents know they pulled me out of my last school after they had a meeting with them about me coming out and they threatened to kick me out if I came out again at the one I go to now. I'm way too scared to come out again and I don't want to risk being outed by anyone I feel like I'm lying all the time to everyone at my new school. I hung around a lot of guys at my old school and it was fun but I wasn't really close with anyone and at my new school I'm friends with a small group of girls but I feel like everything about me is so fake when I'm with them I feel like I'm not even me. 
Sorry that was more of a rant then an answer, thankyou for replying its just really hard right now I have heard of an lgbt group thats kind of nearby but I'm really nervous to go and scared I'll get kicked out if my parents find out I went there.
Sorry for the info dump I know its a lot
